INSERT INTO v5ai_knowledge_chunk (knowledge_base_id, document_id, chunk_index, content, metadata, token_count, content_hash, source_type, vector_id, keyword_tokens, updated_at) VALUES
( #{item.knowledgeBaseId}, #{item.documentId}, #{item.chunkIndex}, #{item.content},
-- metadata 是 JSON 文本串（Worker 写入 "{}" 或对象序列化结果），MySQL 的 JSON 列直接吃字符串 #{item.metadata, jdbcType=OTHER},
-- 核心修复点：加上 jdbcType=OTHER，告诉 MyBatis 不要当字符串传 #{item.metadata, jdbcType=OTHER}::jsonb,
#{item.tokenCount}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.vectorId}, #{item.keywordTokens, typeHandler=xin.v5ai.nb.rag.core.store.TextArrayTypeHandler}, current_timestamp )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content = VALUES(content), metadata = VALUES(metadata), token_count = VALUES(token_count), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), source_type = VALUES(source_type), keyword_tokens = VALUES(keyword_tokens), updated_at = current_timestamp
ON CONFLICT (vector_id) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, token_count = EXCLUDED.token_count, content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash, source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type, keyword_tokens = EXCLUDED.keyword_tokens, updated_at = current_timestamp

SELECT count(*) FROM v5ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE
AND JSON_LENGTH(keyword_tokens) > 0 AND cardinality(keyword_tokens) > 0

SELECT COALESCE(avg(
JSON_LENGTH(keyword_tokens) cardinality(keyword_tokens)
), 0) FROM v5ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE
AND JSON_LENGTH(keyword_tokens) > 0 AND cardinality(keyword_tokens) > 0

SELECT count(*) FROM v5ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE
AND JSON_CONTAINS(keyword_tokens, JSON_QUOTE(#{term,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND keyword_tokens @> ARRAY[#{term,jdbcType=VARCHAR}]::text[]
